description: This file defines the interface CustomerOptionValueService, which extends a generic service interface and provides method declarations for managing CustomerOptionValue objects, including listing by store and language, saving or updating, and retrieving by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueService
classes.description: An interface extending a generic service, providing method signatures for handling customer option values in the system.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customer option values for a specific store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer option value or updates an existing one, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a customer option value based on store and code.
